about: Hurling Heroes: the owner's notes, each a test for good (tools/wsg/owner_notes.gd). Never remove one: tools/wsg/owner_notes_guard.sh fails CI if an id once here is gone.

notes.words: I still do not hear the sound of a clang when the ball is hitting the goal posts, that was built this is a regression.
Regression: the feet are pointing upward again everywhere.
Remove the commentary. We'll try it in a later iteration of the game.
Turn down the outside bird noise a bit. It's overpowering.
After the score there is an awkward closeup of the player who scored moving his hand around, find a different celebration that one makes the arm look broken.
The far lines on the field disappear sometimes or look odd.
at halftime for some reason I watched players run off the field into the woods.
There was a large time jump for some reason while watching an AI game.
Finish of the free take swing is still awkward, does that look like a normal body to you. See screenshot.
put pants on the refs
goal posts turned black
ball disappears in some free take shots
no feet, sunk into the bench
the crowd to the near side is looking the wrong direction
When switching to a camera angle that is not alongside the court the joystick movement is all wrong.
There will NEVER be a time when a player or referee should walk through a table or bench etc. A ball should also bounce off these items.
The refs body and arms still look very weird
when you click start game there is a loading delay ... long enough on the slow phone that users might think the game has frozen
The goalie can be removed

Practice graphics, the middle ground: full detail regardless of tier for the taker, the hurley, the sliotar and the posts; the crowd, the far stands, venue extras and effects follow the player's own tier.
Players are still gliding/hovering some when running or strafing sideways.
